properties.areaDesc: Inyo, CA
properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued October 21 at 5:00PM PDT until October 21 at 6:00PM PDT by NWS Las Vegas NV
properties.description:
FFWVEF

The National Weather Service in Las Vegas has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southern Inyo County in south central California...

* Until 600 PM PDT.

* At 500 PM PDT, emergency management reported thunderstorms
producing heavy rain across the warned area. Flash flooding is
already occurring.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Emergency management reported.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
urban areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Panamint Springs.

Recent thunderstorms have resulted in flooding along Hwy 190 and
around Panamint Valley Road.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

CMAMtext: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 6:00 PM PDT. Avoid flooded areas.
CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 6:00 PM PDT. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

properties.areaDesc: Graham, AZ
properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued October 21 at 4:59PM MST until October 21 at 5:30PM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:
At 459 PM MST, a severe thunderstorm was located near Solomon, moving
northeast at 30 mph.

THIS IS A DESTRUCTIVE STORM FOR SWIFT TRAIL JUNCTION AND SOLOMON.

HAZARD...Baseball size hail and 70 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...People and animals outdoors will be severely injured. Expect
shattered windows, extensive damage to roofs, siding, and
vehicles.

Locations impacted include...
Safford, Thatcher, Solomon, San Jose, Safford Regional Airport,
Roper Lake State Park and Swift Trail Junction.

This includes the following highways...
Route 191 between mile markers 111 and 140. Route 70 between mile
markers 338 and 365.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter now inside an interior room on the lowest floor of a
well-built structure. This storm is capable of producing destructive
hail and widespread damaging winds.

Tornadoes can develop quickly from severe thunderstorms. Seek shelter
immediately in an interior room on the lowest floor of a well-built
structure.

properties.headline: Coastal Flood Warning issued October 21 at 7:59PM EDT until October 22 at 2:00PM EDT by NWS Wakefield VA
properties.description:
* WHAT...One to two feet of inundation above ground level
expected in low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal
waterways.

* WHERE...Dorchester, Wicomico and Somerset Counties.

* WHEN...Until 2 PM EDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Widespread flooding of vulnerable areas will result in
an elevated threat of property damage to homes and businesses
near the waterfront and shoreline. Water will be 1 to 2 feet
above ground level in some areas resulting in a sufficient depth
to close numerous roads and threaten homes and businesses.
Flooding will extend inland from the waterfront along tidal
rivers and bays resulting in some road closures and flooding of
vehicles.
properties.instruction:
Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone property. If
travel is required, do not drive around barricades or through
water of unknown depth.

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued October 21 at 4:53PM PDT until October 21 at 6:15PM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
properties.description:

East Santa Barbara Channel from Pt. Conception to Pt. Mugu CA
including Santa Cruz Island...

offshore including San Nicolas and Santa Barbara Islands...
Point Piedras Blancas to Point Sal from 10 to 60 NM...

including San Miguel and Santa Rosa Islands...

At 452 PM PDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing waterspouts
was located 16 nm west of Point Arguello, or 24 nm west of Point
Conception, moving north at 50 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts, wind gusts in excess of 50 knots, and small
hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Boats could suffer significant structural
damage in high winds. Small craft could capsize in suddenly
higher waves.

Locations impacted include...
West Point Santa Cruz Island, Point Arguello, Point Sal, Morro Bay,
Santa Rosa Island, San Miguel Island, Point Conception, Cambria, and
Goleta Point.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor immediately as gusty winds and high waves are
expected.

Thunderstorms can produce sudden waterspouts. Waterspouts can easily
overturn boats and create locally hazardous seas. Seek safe harbor
immediately.
